title: Browser Web APIs
definition: Web APIs are threads provided by the browser environment (not the JS engine itself) that handle asynchronous operations like `fetch`, `setTimeout`, and DOM events outside the main JS thread.
simpleExplanation: JavaScript is a manager who delegates slow tasks (like fetching a file) to his assistants (Web APIs). When the assistant finishes, they put the result in the Task Queue for the manager to look at later.

answers.question: What is the main bottleneck for Browser Web APIs?
answers.answer: Usually network latency or CPU-bound synchronous tasks blocking the main thread.
